desc:
🌙 Tonight, the shop must stay open.
You are alone guarding the cashier until morning. Customers keep coming...
but not all of the customers who come are real. 👁️

🐯 LATEST UPDATE: SANGIT IS COMING!
Exactly at 3 AM, Sangit passed by riding a tiger accompanied by music.
He stopped in front of the small shop and performed with his cat.
Then he made an invitation...
"Do you want to go to the moon with me?" 🌕
Join or decline? Your choice will determine the end of your night.

✨ NEW GOOD ENDING: FLY TO THE MOON!

📦 Previous Update:
• New thief, more challenging
• Can sell Chicken Noodles and Meatballs
• The stall was expanded
• New door, larger area

⚠️ GAME IS STILL IN BETA!
The map, NPCs, and endings are still under development.
🐛 Found a bug? Report it to the developers.

Guard the shop. Check the CCTV. Hold on until morning. 🌙
